references.label: Six-target left bank
references.description: Left-side bank that starts the 80,000-point, Special, and replay cycle.

references.label: Target-cycle follow-up lane
references.description: Lane lit after all six left targets are down; completing it resets the bank and advances the cycle.

references.label: Four progressive targets
references.description: Upper-right targets that advance Bonus X through 20x.

references.label: A-B-C-D lanes
references.description: Four lanes whose first completion lights Extra Ball and second completion awards Special.

references.label: Yellow Extra Ball target
references.description: Target that collects Extra Ball after the first A-B-C-D completion.

references.label: Three pop bumpers
references.description: Bumpers that can be lit through paired stars for 100,000-point hits.
